vulnerability_mechanism.detail: At v1.8.0, to_abs_path uses os.path.normpath, is_path_trusted applies a lexical startswith containment test, and GET /file passes the original path to FileResponse after that check. A symlink inside an allowed tree can therefore pass the unresolved check and be followed to an external target when access control is enabled.

atomic_bic.detail: git log --all --reverse -S searches for def is_path_trusted and def get_enable_access_control both first resolve to 5f98c26b86f7e6bc049131441dd3a6aa5c2f0670. Its diff first adds normpath-based trust checking, the access-control switch, and check_path_trust before FileResponse; the later 9abda84d39c0700105df7a9c528c30dcccc16c82 only extracts the existing normalization into to_abs_path.

immediate_parent_absence.detail: 5f98c26b86f7e6bc049131441dd3a6aa5c2f0670 has the single immediate parent 684dcb63fae43ca8edefc3f98c9ee6b7f4845b75. Exact parent-tree grep finds none of is_path_trusted, check_path_trust, get_enable_access_control, enable_access_control, or IIB_ACCESS_CONTROL, and the parent GET /file serves FileResponse without a confinement check.

squash_member_decomposition.detail: The BIC is a normal single-parent public commit, not a merge or squash aggregate; rev-list over the BIC excluding its immediate parent contains exactly one object, so no finer public member exists to decompose.

affected_fixed_release_membership.detail: The authoritative CVE record is PUBLISHED and declares semver 0 through 1.8.0 affected. Every local v0.0.1 through v1.8.0 tag contains the BIC and excludes direct fix d1a6a818c00ee7ab4b058f585df8deb2426362f2; v1.9.0 contains both the direct fix and merge 4057a624c7a23a36f0b4dc6a545b40767d602450. GHSA withdrawn_at is null.

direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state.detail: d1a6a818c00ee7ab4b058f585df8deb2426362f2 changes to_abs_path from normpath to realpath and hardens the parent prefix with os.sep. Merge 4057a624c7a23a36f0b4dc6a545b40767d602450 has the direct fix as its second parent, and its first-parent patch-id for the two causal files exactly matches the direct-fix patch-id.

bic_only_ai_attribution.detail: The BIC object names zanllp <qc@zanllp.cn> as author and committer and has no AI/bot/co-author trailer, but a human-looking identity plus absent explicit markers does not prove human-only authorship. No BIC-local evidence supplied or independently recovered closes the NOT_AI gate.

findings: The primary correctly identifies the vulnerability lifecycle, atomic BIC, parent state, affected/fixed release boundary, and direct fix.
The primary NOT_AI verdict is unsupported because it treats absent explicit AI markers and a human author identity as affirmative proof of human authorship.
introducer_parent_absent is false even though the primary evidence and independent replay both establish that the vulnerable access-control mechanism is absent from the immediate parent.

corrected_fields.ai_marker: No explicit AI marker is present in the BIC commit object; this is insufficient to establish human-only authorship.

remaining_gap: BIC-local evidence establishing whether the causal code was written by a human or generated with AI is unavailable; author/committer identity and absent trailers alone cannot close attribution.
